title: GaP-MoE : Explicit Expert Specialization in Mixture-of-Experts via Orthogonal Gradient Accumulation and Projection
abstract: arXiv:2610.29355v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) models improve scalability by routing input tokens to only a subset of expert networks, but they often suffer from representation collapse, in which multiple experts converge toward similar functions and lose their intended diversity. Prior work has addressed this limitation either by improving router architectures or by introducing auxiliary loss terms that implicitly penalize similarity among experts. However, router-based approaches remain vulnerable to routing collapses, and loss-based approaches can conflict with the task's original objective during optimization. In this work, we propose GaP-MoE (Gradient Accumulation and Projection in MoE), which induces expert specialization by directly manipulating expert output gradients rather than modifying the loss function. translated_title: GaP-MoE：通过正交梯度累积与投影实现专家混合模型中的显式专家专业化
translated_abstract: 稀疏专家混合模型通过将输入令牌仅路由到专家网络的一个子集来提升可扩展性，但这类模型常常遭受表示坍缩问题，即多个专家收敛到相似的函数并丧失其预期的多样性。先前的工作要么通过改进路由器架构，要么通过引入隐式惩罚专家之间相似性的辅助损失项来解决这一局限。然而，基于路由器的方法仍然容易受到路由坍缩的影响，而基于损失的方法在优化过程中可能与任务原始目标发生冲突。在本工作中，我们提出了GaP-MoE（MoE中的梯度累积与投影），该方法通过直接操纵专家输出梯度而非修改损失函数来诱导专家专业化。在每个训练步骤中，GaP-MoE基于归一化路由分数，从TopK路由的专家中随机选择一个专家作为领导者……
tldr: 提出GaP-MoE方法，通过正交梯度累积与投影直接操纵专家输出梯度而非修改损失函数，从而在稀疏专家混合模型中诱导显式的专家专业化，解决表示坍缩问题。
en_tdlr: GaP-MoE induces explicit expert specialization in sparse Mixture-of-Experts by directly manipulating expert output gradients through orthogonal gradient accumulation and projection, addressing representation collapse without modifying the loss function.
